visual.general_description: Color photograph of a large resected polypoid specimen on a dark background beside a ruler, with an inset endoscopic view of the esophageal lumen.
visual.detailed_description: Main image: an elongated, lobulated cream, yellow-tan and pink tissue mass with a smooth, partly reddened surface and folded pale tissue at its upper left, lying on a dark surface above a printed ruler; the numerals 0, 1, 2, 6 and 7 are legible and a 3 is only partly visible (the specimen covers the ruler between 3 and 6). Inset at lower right: an endoscopic view of a pink mucosal lumen in which a rounded pink mass occupies part of the lumen; an open arrow points to a pale area at the mass edge. A faint, unreadable streak of light marks lies in the black border at the top right of the inset (possibly endoscope overlay text); it cannot be read as a date or name. No panel letters or other legible text are visible beyond the ruler numerals; the ruler unit is not printed.
